note_manual: Printed inconsistencies visible in the crops: (1) Eq. (2) prints ε = (4π/3V_tot)Σ(R_k + R_p)³ although the sentence before defines ε = 1 − (V_AM + V_CBD)/V_tot (the printed right-hand side is the solid fraction); (2) δ_e = 'R_p + d50/100 = 0.40 µm' — R_p + d50/100 = 0.34 + 0.121 = 0.461 µm; 0.40 µm needs d50/200 (1 % of the radius) [card arithmetic]; (3) (h_i − d50)/h_i = (87 − 12.1)/87 = 0.861, not '≃0.89' [card arithmetic]; (4) the rebound estimate uses f_a = 1360 µN (= k_p R_p of the sphere–sphere contact) with k1 = 4.7 kN/m of the sphere–cylinder contact, while Table 2 gives the sphere–cylinder contact k_p = 0 and γ = 0; (5) Table 2 γ (34 · 240 mJ/m²) and k_p (4 · 27.5 kN/m) are not connected by Eqs. (8)–(9) for micron radii: k_p R_p = 2πγR* needs R* ≈ 6.4 mm with mJ/m² (≈ 6.4 µm with J/m²) [card arithmetic]; (6) Table 2 k_t/k2 = 0.828 (Sph–Col) and 0.836 (Sph–Cyl) imply ν* = 0.294 / 0.281 with Eq. (11), but ν* = (1/ν1 + 1/ν2)^−1 ≤ 0.25 for any ν ≤ 0.5 [card arithmetic]; (7) Fig. 7 pairs each speed's σ_max (= Fig. 5d) with the porosity of the reversed speed order in Fig. 5c (0.5 ↔ 5 and 1 ↔ 2 m/min, equal to 1e-4 %p) — one of the two figures has its porosity colours swapped [판독 · vector]; (8) Fig. 4(a) starts at 40.6 % while the text says 'The initial porosity is 0.44' [판독]; (9) Fig. 3 ζ axis has points at ζ = 0.04 (panel a only) outside the stated 0.05–0.25 range; (10) Fig. 6(a) Z at C_r 42.5 % = 6.27–6.34 vs text '6.4' [판독]; (11) text 'If the contact becomes non-slipping again, δn will be cumulated' (δ_t meant); (12) Ref. [3] (Kwade 2018, production review) is cited for a voxel-size sensitivity analysis; Ref. [23] is a geotechnical impact-roller paper cited for electrode elongation; Ref. [43] (PRE 84, 011306) printed with journal name 'Batteries'; affiliation 'Grenoble Alples'.

digitized_note: digitized.csv = vector drawing coordinates (all plot glyphs are outlines, no text layer): axis map = least-squares line through the tick-mark paths (1.27 pt strokes on the frame) with the printed tick values; marker = bbox centre of its circle / triangle path (matplotlib '^' is symmetric about its bbox centre); error bars = the vertical path of the same colour through the marker; legend markers excluded (legend boxes = white rects/paths inside the axes); Fig. 4 curves sampled every 100 µs by linear interpolation between path vertices plus the extreme vertices; fit lines sampled at listed x.  Experimental triangles reproduce Table 1 to ≤ 0.01 (C_f, elongation, porosity).
